name: agent-ai-opencode
description: Agen OpenCode V2 lewat Telegram dengan memori jangka panjang dan skill hasil belajar

scripts.build: npm run build -w @aao/memory && npm run build -w @grinev/opencode-telegram-bot
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @aao/memory && npm run typecheck -w @grinev/opencode-telegram-bot
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e -w @aao/memory && node scripts/e2e-bot.mjs
